docs.title: Momento Constitution
docs.body:
# Momento Constitution

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Project | Momento Core Platform |
| Document | Momento Constitution |
| Version | 2.0 |
| Status | Draft |
| Authority | Highest Design Authority |

## 1. Purpose

The Momento Constitution defines the permanent principles governing the design,
development, operation, and evolution of the Momento platform. Every future
feature, engine, module, API, visualization, AI model, and data process must
support the original mission of Momento.

It prevents architectural drift, unnecessary complexity, unexplainable
intelligence, domain lock-in, and unreliable conclusions.

## 2. Mission

Momento exists to transform sequential event data into explainable, continuously
improving intelligence. The platform observes reality, converts observations into
structured knowledge, discovers patterns, generates intelligence, and learns from
outcomes.

## 3. Core Philosophy — Observation Before Prediction

    Observation -> Validation -> Structured Events -> Features -> Knowledge -> Intelligence -> Prediction

Prediction without understanding is speculation.

## 4. The Twelve Articles of Momento

- **I — Purpose**: Every component must contribute to explainable intelligence.
- **II — Truth**: Raw observations are immutable; corrections are recorded separately.
- **III — Observation**: All intelligence begins with observation; no engine consumes uncontrolled external data.
- **IV — Knowledge**: Momento reasons from knowledge (features, states, patterns), not raw events.
- **V — Explainability**: Every intelligence output must have a reason and confidence.
- **VI — Learning**: Every resolved outcome improves future intelligence.
- **VII — Visualization**: Visualization is an intelligence interface, not decoration.
- **VIII — Modularity**: Core stays independent from individual domains.
- **IX — Extensibility**: New capabilities are added through extensions; Core stays stable.
- **X — Validation**: Every subsystem must prove reliability (unit, integration, replay, historical, live).
- **XI — Human-Centered Intelligence**: Momento reduces cognitive load.
- **XII — Evolution**: Momento evolves while preserving reproducibility and backward compatibility.

## 5. Feature Approval Framework

Before adding anything, answer: Purpose, Necessity, Separation, Measurement, Evolution.

## 6. Architecture Decision Records

- **ADR-001** — Momento is a Prediction Intelligence Platform (not a single algorithm).
- **ADR-002** — Raw Events Are Immutable.
- **ADR-003** — Observation Engine Is the Entry Point.
- **ADR-004** — Explainability Is Mandatory.

docs.title: Vision & Product Definition
docs.body:
# Vision and Product Definition

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Document | 01_Vision_and_Product_Definition |
| Version | 2.0 |
| Status | Draft |

## What Momento Is

Momento is a modular analytics and forecasting platform that collects, processes,
analyzes, forecasts, and visualizes event streams in real time. It is a prediction
**intelligence platform**, not a single prediction algorithm.

## Who It Serves

- Operators who need live monitoring and system control (Admin Platform).
- End users who want an explainable prediction experience (Consumer Application).
- Future AI agents and dashboards that consume a stable forecasting core.

## What It Does

Observe event streams, structure them into knowledge, detect patterns, produce
explainable forecasts with confidence, and learn continuously from outcomes.

## What It Does Not Do

Momento does not trap intelligence inside a single application, edit raw history,
or produce predictions without explanations.

## Long-Term Direction

    Momento Core Backend
            | API
    Applications (Admin, Consumer, Mobile, Future Agents)

Build the intelligence platform first. Build the beautiful experience second.

## Success Criteria

Reproducible forecasts, measurable engine outputs, explainable predictions,
backward-compatible evolution, and a Core that outlives any single algorithm.

docs.title: Platform Architecture
docs.body:
# Platform Architecture

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Document | 03_Platform_Architecture |
| Version | 2.0 |
| Status | Draft |

## Module Pipeline

    Collector -> Backend API -> Analysis -> Forecast Engine -> Database -> Dashboard

Each module has a single responsibility.

## The Momento Kernel (Phase 1 — Protect the Kernel)

    Round Event Model | Database Layer | Schema Contracts | Runtime
    Event Bus | API Contracts | Engine Registry

## Collection Architecture (Phase 2)

    Browser Collector | WebSocket Collector | CSV Import Collector
        -> Normalizer -> Event Bus -> Core Database

## Intelligence Layer (Phase 3)

    Pattern Engine -> DNA Engine -> Similarity Engine
        -> Probability Engine -> Confidence Engine -> Forecast Engine

Each engine has clear contracts, is independently tested, replaceable, and
produces measurable outputs.

## Platform Applications (Phase 4)

- **Admin Platform** — live monitoring, collector status, engine health, calibration, data explorer.
- **Consumer Application** — auth, subscription, forecast display, confidence indicators, history.

## Local vs Production

- Local: SQLite, local API, local dashboard — fast development.
- Production: Vercel, Render, Supabase, cloud collector.
- Never remove local functionality when adding production support.

docs.title: MDOS Overview
docs.body:
# MDOS — Meta Development Operating System

MDOS is a complete Engineering Operating System that enables humans and AI agents
to collaboratively design, build, validate, document, and evolve complex software
systems. It is project-agnostic: Momento is the first project running on it.

## Core Philosophy

- Knowledge is the source of truth.
- Projects are generated from knowledge; tasks from projects; agents execute tasks.
- Validation verifies results; documentation updates after approved work.
- No duplicate knowledge. Everything references everything. Everything is searchable and versioned.

## Modules

Dashboard, Projects, Knowledge Base, Architecture, Agents, Skills, Tasks,
Roadmaps, Workflows, Templates, Decision Records, Testing, Validation, Search,
Settings, Activity, Notifications, Repositories, Integrations, Documentation,
Analytics.

Each module is independently extensible.

## Portability

The entire workspace serializes to `mdos.workspace.json`. Import it into any MDOS
instance to restore all projects, knowledge, agents, skills, workflows, decisions,
tasks, and documents. This package is that export.

docs.title: Deploy Guide
docs.body:
# Deploy MDOS

This package is a self-contained, importable MDOS workspace.

## Quick Deploy (static web)

```bash
bun install
bun run build
# outputs ./dist — deploy to any static host
```

## Deploy to Vercel

```bash
npm i -g vercel
vercel --prod
```

## Deploy to Netlify

```bash
npm i -g netlify-cli
netlify deploy --prod --dir=dist
```

## Import the workspace

Open MDOS and use **IMPORT** to load `mdos.workspace.json`. This restores the
full Momento seed (Constitution, Articles, ADRs, agents, skills, workflows).
